title: C400GT Premium Maxi
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the BMW Motorrad C400GT Premium Maxi is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 400cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
